title: Parse batched task documents straight from the cat-file output instead of copying every body
outcome: Parse batched task documents straight from the cat-file output instead of copying every body
acceptance: Reader::batch hands each document to its caller as a slice of the chunk's cat-file output, or read_documents parses each record as it is read, so peak memory for a batched read stays near one copy of the payload rather than the chunk output plus a copy of every body
A behaviour test reads a batch of documents and gets them byte-identical, and existing task_sync::git tests pass
